workload: In-process Manager.Wait scanning 5000 retained lines; regex ^MATCH$ matches the last line; since=-1; requested before-context 0, 3 and 256. Fake terminals remove PTY/process setup noise. Existing ring and matching behavior are unchanged.
method: Five 200ms samples per build and context, before/after alternated each round on an otherwise quiet host. Raw stdout includes platform and CPU. Median ns/op, B/op and allocs/op.
limits: This measures a full retained-history scan, not all HTTP calls or idle-session retained memory. No production per-terminal fields or timers were added.

validation.allocation_guard_red_baseline: Both context=0 and context=3 fail against the baseline Manager via an absolute canonical-path Go overlay, including under -race: 45 vs 5044 and 45 vs 1297 allocs.
validation.affected_full_race: go test -race ./internal/terminal ./internal/api passed on rerun; terminal 20.683s
validation.fixture_race: An initial full run hit an existing permissions-test nil dereference while e.Info raced a checkpoint. Forcing the real checkpoint between ReadDir and Info with baseline production code reproduced ENOENT on tail.0.
validation.permission_fix: Lock the existing ckptMu during the directory walk and check every stat/read error. Present-file permission checks remain strict. Targeted -race -count=12 passed.
